AccountName.description: Name of the ad account the row reports on.

CampaignName.description: Name of the campaign the row reports on.

CampaignId.description: The Microsoft Advertising assigned identifier of a campaign. FK to [Campaigns](./campaigns.md)

AdGroupName.description: Name of the ad group the row reports on.

AdType.description: Type of the ad the row reports on.

Conversions.description: Conversions for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off). Deprecated by Microsoft in 2022: it returns 0 going forward, so use `ConversionsQualified`.

ConversionRate.description: Conversions divided by clicks, times 100, for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off); `AllConversionRate` covers all goals.

CostPerConversion.description: Spend divided by conversions, for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off); only campaigns with conversion tracking add conversions.

AdStatus.description: Status of the ad the row reports on.

Revenue.description: Revenue the advertiser reports for conversions of goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off); `AllRevenue` covers all goals.

ReturnOnAdSpend.description: Revenue divided by spend (ROAS), for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off).

RevenuePerConversion.description: `Revenue` divided by conversions, for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off).

AccountStatus.description: Status of the ad account the row reports on.

CampaignStatus.description: Status of the campaign the row reports on.

AdGroupStatus.description: Status of the ad group the row reports on.

CustomerName.description: Name of the Microsoft Advertising customer that owns the account.

CampaignType.description: Type of the campaign; Microsoft lists values such as Audience, Dynamic search, Search & content and Shopping.

AllConversions.description: Conversions for all goals, including those excluded from bidding. Deprecated by Microsoft in 2022: it returns 0 going forward, so use `AllConversionsQualified`.

AllRevenue.description: Revenue the advertiser reports for conversions of all goals, including those excluded from bidding.

AllConversionRate.description: Conversions divided by clicks, times 100, for all goals, including those excluded from bidding.

AllCostPerConversion.description: Spend divided by conversions, for all goals, including those excluded from bidding; only campaigns with conversion tracking add conversions.

AllReturnOnAdSpend.description: Revenue divided by spend (ROAS), for all goals, including those excluded from bidding.

AllRevenuePerConversion.description: `AllRevenue` divided by conversions, for all goals, including those excluded from bidding.

ViewThroughConversions.description: Conversions by people who saw but did not click an ad, counted only for Microsoft Audience network ads. Deprecated by Microsoft in 2022: it returns 0 going forward, so use `ViewThroughConversionsQualified`.

ConversionsQualified.description: Conversions for goals counted in bidding (ExcludeFromBidding off); the column to use instead of the deprecated `Conversions`. Microsoft returns it as a decimal number.

AllConversionsQualified.description: Conversions for all goals, including those excluded from bidding; the column to use instead of the deprecated `AllConversions`. Microsoft returns it as a decimal number.

ViewThroughConversionsQualified.description: Conversions by people who saw but did not click an ad, counted only for Microsoft Audience network ads; the column to use instead of the deprecated `ViewThroughConversions`.

AverageWatchTimePerVideoView.alias: Average Watch Time Per Video View

StateOrProvinceCode.description: Code of the state or province, next to `CountryCode` and `City`.

Downloads.description: The number of times customers downloaded apps through the ads.

CostPerDownload.description: Spend divided by `Downloads`: the average amount charged each time the ad led to a download.

AppInstalls.description: The number of times customers installed apps through the ads.

Purchases.description: The number of times customers used the ads to make a purchase in the app.

Subscriptions.description: The number of times customers used the ads to buy a subscription in a game.
